title: Architectural__GAN_3D
summary: A GAN-based pipeline for generating 3D architectural models in STL/M3D format from XML and DXF contour data, using tabular data generation as an intermediate step. The trainer scripts call CTGAN directly to synthesize sample rows and use SDV's evaluate_quality function to assess the synthetic tabular output.
evidence: trainer.py:59 'data = ctgan.sample(300)' and 'from sdv.evaluation.single_table import evaluate_quality'
needs: Unclear whether CTGAN-generated tabular data feeds directly into the 3D STL/M3D generation model or is a separate experimental branch.
